entries: {DISASTER:strikes} hit {place}, and {first} was paid to see nothing at {landmark}.
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and it was worth killing for.
The {rival} blamed {DISASTER} on {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, and {first} was offered a cut to agree.
{SOMEONE:!plural} drifted into {place} {MANNER} and wanted {first} to lend a hand.
{first} took a job to {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE}, and wondered who was paying.
